prompt: Write a logscan package: logscan/__init__.py re-exporting load_entries, count_levels and top_level, logscan/reader.py where load_entries(path) reads a log file of one JSON object per line (skipping blank lines and raising ValueError on a line that is not valid JSON) and count_levels(entries) maps each entry's level to its number of occurrences, and logscan/stats.py where top_level(entries) returns the level with the highest count, breaking ties alphabetically and raising ValueError when there are no entries.
